integrity: The proof starts from the published minimal facet system, projects every facet normal into the intrinsic codimension-two affine span, and minimizes the exact normalized clearance over all bisubset types. Global optimality follows by orthogonal permutation averaging, and uniqueness follows from the 2n tangent coordinate-type facets. Finite exhaustive enumeration is corroborative only.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns the standard Euclidean realization of the bipermutahedron. It determines the inradius, the unique incenter for n at least 3, the full exceptional n=2 incenter set, and the tangent facets. It does not determine enclosing spheres, extremal ellipsoids, or radii of arbitrary deformations of the bipermutahedral fan.
title: The bipermutahedron has a unique origin inball supported by only \(2n\) facets
